title: Headless Anywhere I Wander (VTechatticup): Private Renolds asks the player to free the two NCR prisoners in the Legion-held mine (stage 10); both freed by their message boxes (20); Renolds thanks the player (stage 100)

actions.text: Path: Renolds (Topic000, 002: stage 10); each prisoner (TecMineHostage) activated, its box's button 1 frees it and counts it; with both freed the quest script sets stage 20; Renolds (009: 100, complete). The trip and the Legionaries in the mine are not walked: travel is move_player, the prisoners are reached unseen.

A Legion explorer from Nelson calls StartConversation on the player as its cell loads (nvNelsonExplorerBarkSCRIPT; the engine starts it at once, StartConversation's walk-up is a stand-in). The player answers peacefully (Topic009, then 010: go before the Decanus).
The quest script runs every 5 seconds (default delay): one run sets HostagesFreed, the next stage 20.
